Title: Silicone Patches
Body (HTML):
Silicone Patches are the bold upgrade your apparel deserves. Crafted with 3D flexibility and sleek, raised details (1.5mm depth), they give any text or design a modern, standout finish. Ideal for apparel, bags, shoes, and promo items, these trending patches add a unique edge to every collection. Silicone Patches have a max of 5 colors, designs with more than 5 colors may have additional costs.

Each patch order includes a free roll of Thermal Tape.
